    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Toml
    Parses and writes TOML 1.1 documents.
    TomlArray
    A TOML array.
    TomlBinder<T>
    Binds tables to a record, and converts the record back to a table.
    TomlBindings
    The conversions that the code the annotation processor generates binds and writes values with.
    TomlBindings.Context
    Where a value is in the document, and how to bind it.
    TomlBindings.Converter<T>
    Converts a value.
    TomlBoolean
    A TOML boolean.
    TomlConfig
    Marks a record that documents bind to, with Toml.parse(String, Class) or Toml.bind(TomlTable, Class).
    TomlDocument
    A parsed document: its root table, and where its keys and values are written.
    TomlFloat
    A TOML float.
    TomlInteger
    A TOML integer.
    TomlKey
    Gives the key of a record component, or the string of an enum constant, in place of its name in kebab case.
    TomlLocalDate
    A TOML local date, such as 1979-05-27.
    TomlLocalDateTime
    A TOML local date-time, such as 1979-05-27T07:32:00.
    TomlLocalTime
    A TOML local time, such as 07:32:00.
    TomlMappingException
    Thrown when a value does not bind to the type it is bound to, as when an integer is bound to a String.
    TomlOffsetDateTime
    A TOML offset date-time, such as 1979-05-27T07:32:00-08:00.
    TomlParseException
    Thrown when a document is not valid TOML.
    TomlPosition
    A position in a document: a line and a column.
    TomlPositions
    Where the keys and values of a parsed document are written, to report a problem with one at its line and column.
    TomlResourceBundle
    A resource bundle whose resources are the values of a TOML table.
    TomlResourceBundleProvider
    Provides TomlResourceBundles to a named module, which cannot load them with TomlResourceBundle.control().
    TomlResourceBundleProvider.Opener
    Opens resources, with the access of the module that provides the bundles.
    TomlString
    A TOML string.
    TomlTable
    A TOML table: keys mapped to values, in the order the keys were given or appeared in the document.
    TomlTable.Builder
    Builds a TomlTable, keeping its entries in the order they are put.
    TomlValue
    A TOML value: a table, an array, or a scalar.
    UnknownKeys
    What binding does with a key of a table that no component of the record takes.
